hook.say: How much do you know about Ataturk and the birth of modern Turkey? Five questions on key dates!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Who was the founder and first president of the Republic of Türkiye?
questions.say: Who was the founder and first president of the Republic of Turkey?
questions.fact: Atatürk served as president from 1923 until his death in 1938.
questions.sayAnswer: Mustafa Kemal Ataturk! He served as president from 1923 until his death in 1938.

questions.q: On which date was the Republic of Türkiye proclaimed?
questions.say: On which date was the Republic of Turkey proclaimed?
questions.fact: 29 October is celebrated every year as Republic Day.
questions.sayAnswer: The 29th of October, 1923! It is celebrated every year as Republic Day.

questions.q: In which city was Atatürk born in 1881?
questions.say: In which city was Ataturk born in 1881?
questions.fact: His birthplace, then called Salonica, is now in Greece.
questions.sayAnswer: Thessaloniki! His birthplace, then called Salonica, is now in Greece.

questions.q: In which year did Türkiye adopt its Latin-based alphabet?
questions.say: In which year did Turkey adopt its Latin-based alphabet?
questions.fact: The Turkish alphabet has 29 letters, with no Q, W or X.
questions.sayAnswer: 1928! The Turkish alphabet has 29 letters, with no Q, W or X.

questions.q: In which year did Mustafa Kemal receive the surname Atatürk?
questions.say: In which year did Mustafa Kemal receive the surname Ataturk?
questions.fact: Parliament gave him the name, meaning Father of the Turks.
questions.sayAnswer: 1934! Parliament gave him the name, which means Father of the Turks.
